extracted.name: Cinnamon Sweet Potato Slices
extracted.description: Wonderful baked sweet potato slices with a perfect blend of flavors from cinnamon, sugar, and butter. This makes an easy side to go with any meal.
ingredient_lines: 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/2 inch thick
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Arrange sweet potato slices on the baking sheet. Brush with 1/2 of the butter. Mix sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl and sprinkle 1/2 over the potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Turn, brush with remaining butter, and sprinkle with remaining cinnamon and sugar. Continue baking until tender, about 15 minutes.
